item.title: Late goal sinks Mini Kulas in 1-0 loss to NZ
item.description: Mini Kulas suffered a heartbreaking 1-0 loss to New Zealand after conceding a late goal at the OFC U-16 Women’s Championship 2026. Fiji looked set to hold the title favourites to a draw after keeping New Zealand scoreless for almost the entire match.
item.content:encoded:
Mini Kulas suffered a heartbreaking 1-0 loss to New Zealand after conceding a late goal at the OFC U-16 Women’s Championship 2026.

Fiji looked set to hold the title favourites to a draw after keeping New Zealand scoreless for almost the entire match.

However, Bonnie Rice struck in the closing stages to snatch the victory for New Zealand and deny Fiji a valuable result.

The win secured New Zealand a place in the semi-finals.

Fiji had earlier made an impressive start to the championship, thrashing the Cook Islands 11-0 in their opening match.

Fiji will now look to bounce back when they take on the Solomon Islands at 8pm Saturday.

The semi-finals will be played next Wednesday, with the final scheduled for next Saturday.

The winner and runner-up will qualify for the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup 2027.

item.title: Jerry Sam appointed new Labasa Football Coach as Alvin Chand steps down
item.description: Jerry Sam has been appointed as the new Labasa Football Coach after Alvin Chand stepped down from the position due to personal reasons and ongoing work commitments. The Labasa Football Association has welcomed Sam into his new role and wished him well as he takes on the responsibility of leading the Babasiga Lions.
item.content:encoded:
Jerry Sam has been appointed as the new Labasa Football Coach after Alvin Chand stepped down from the position due to personal reasons and ongoing work commitments.

The Labasa Football Association has welcomed Sam into his new role and wished him well as he takes on the responsibility of leading the Babasiga Lions.

The Association has also expressed its sincere appreciation to Chand for his dedication, commitment and service to the Babasiga Lions during his time as Head Coach.

It says Chand’s contribution to the team and the wider Labasa football family is greatly valued, and thanked him for his efforts and professionalism.

The Association says it respects Chand’s decision and wishes him success and happiness in his future commitments.

Labasa won the Battle of the Giants title last year, however, failed to qualify for the semi finals this year.

item.title: OFC Women’s U-16 Championship: Mini Kulas face crucial New Zealand test in Honiara
item.description: Fiji head into the match full of confidence following an impressive 11-0 victory over the Cook Islands in their opening match. Adi Reva starred in the dominant opening performance, becoming the first Fijian player to score five goals in a single match at the tournament.
item.content:encoded:
Fiji head into the match full of confidence following an impressive 11-0 victory over the Cook Islands in their opening match.

Adi Reva starred in the dominant opening performance, becoming the first Fijian player to score five goals in a single match at the tournament.

Head coach Nicola Demaine has urged her players to stay focused and not get carried away by the big opening win.

New Zealand will present a much tougher challenge, and Fiji will need another disciplined and clinical performance to secure a crucial victory.
